authors: Cuchiero, C., Keller-Ressel, M. and Teichmann, J.
title: Polynomial processes and their applications to mathematical finance
annotation: Markov processes whose generator maps polynomials of degree n to polynomials of degree at most n, so that moments follow from a finite matrix exponential; the square-root process and its integral are examples, used here for exact cumulants under a switching level.

title: A deterministic-shift extension of analytically-tractable and time-homogeneous short-rate models
annotation: Develops deterministic-shift extensions of tractable short-rate models and derives analytical formulas for bonds and bond options; the payoff-transport theorem on the bond-options page isolates the underlying maturity-by-maturity scaling rule.

authors: Geman, H., El Karoui, N. and Rochet, J.-C.
title: Changes of numéraire, changes of probability measure and option pricing
annotation: Establishes the general change-of-numeraire theorem and forward measures used here to fix the sign and normalization of the futures recursion.
